Input2 is original pixel source identity and pose reference. TRUE TRANSPARENT background everywhere outside objects; no backdrop, checkerboard, scenery, labels, text, watermark, glows or external shadows. Fully isolated inside cells with generous clear transparent gutters. Redesign Input2 as exactly EIGHT poses of the SAME simple solid downward triangular pointer on a regular4-column by2-row sprite sheet, row-major order. Neutral SILVER-WHITE facets with dark charcoal contours; NO gold, colour or badge, because runtime tints red/blue/bright. Aim2048x1024, equal512px square cells, art inside middle70percent of each cell.
